(Currently Amended) 1. A method for restoring efficiency of a photovoltaic cell, the method comprising: illuminating a photovoltaic cell such that the photovoltaic cell receives a time-averaged irradiance that is equivalent to at least 5 hours of solar illumination; and annealing the photovoltaic cell at a temperature above 90 degrees Celsius for a minimum of 10 minutes, the annealing occurring after illuminating the photovoltaic cell.

(Currently Amended) 2. The method of Claim 1, wherein the photovoltaic cell comprises a semiconductor wafer, and one of: wherein the photovoltaic cell receives a time-averaged irradiance that is equivalent to at least 20 hours of solar illumination; wherein the photovoltaic cell receives a time-averaged irradiance that is equivalent to at least 16 hours of solar illumination while being heated to at least 50 degrees Celsius; and wherein the photovoltaic cell is irradiated in sunlight using a solar concentrator for at least 10 hours, and wherein the solar concentrator increases the irradiance of solar illumination on the photovoltaic cell by a factor of 2 to 5.

(Currently Amended) 3. The method of Claim 2, wherein the photovoltaic cell is annealed at a temperature above 130 degrees Celsius, and wherein annealing the photovoltaic cell further comprises illuminating the photovoltaic cell.

(Currently Amended) 4. The method of Claim 3, wherein illuminating the photovoltaic cell during annealing is performed such that the photovoltaic cell receives a time-averaged irradiance equivalent to at least 10 minutes of solar illumination.
